newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China opens $361 million bridge across Pearl River.
newsitem.headline: China opens $361 million bridge across Pearl River.

text.p: China has opened the nation's longest suspension bridge in the booming southern province of Guangdong, the Shenzhen Special Zone Daily said on Thursday.
The three billion yuan ($361.4 million) Humen bridge, which stretches across the mouth of the Pearl River, cuts the travelling distance between the cities of Zhuhai and Shenzhen by 100 km (60 miles).
The cities are on opposite sides of the Pearl River Delta.
The newspaper said the structure has a span of 888 metres (2,930 ft).
